decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy gained visibility, moving to the home page in 2024, fits the firm's mental health core at low marginal cost, and its insurer-funded demand is still unfolding, so the option is worth keeping open.
Senior living counseling has stayed on the home page for two years, costs little to run, and feeds the core eldercare business, so its evidence supports keeping it.
The sheltered workshop retail shop was promoted to the home page in 2024, which signals positive early results, and it uses existing production capacity at modest cost, so it stays.

Meal delivery for seniors was launched only in 2024 and is merely mentioned, so its value is still uncertain, but it complements eldercare and is cheap to keep while results come in, unlike the dropped A and B.
